name: Poosh
summary:
Welcome to Poosh, an immersive VR adventure that lets you experience the wild world of monkeys like never before! In Poosh, you'll master gorilla-style locomotion, using intuitive movements to swing through trees, climb rocky cliffs, and explore vibrant, lush jungles.
